source: Statistics Canada 2021 boundary file, federal electoral districts (2013 Representation Order), used under the Representation Act, 2015 adoption of those boundaries for provincial districts; 116 of 124 districts are namesakes. 8 northern districts are carved from 5 federal polygons and resolve as candidate sets only.
upgradePath: Replace geometry with the official Elections Ontario electoral-district shapefile (limited-use licence acceptance at elections.on.ca) and re-run build_fsa_provincial.py against it; the join, carve and test code is geometry-source agnostic.
reshaped: 2026-10-30 — same offline reshape as federal; names rendered from roster by memberId (also removes the Hon.-prefix display defect D-4)
rule: sliver <0.01 land-area share dropped unless nothing remains; carve-candidate => candidates; 1 survivor => resolved
